Park Circus
Let them eat cake! Marie Antoinette returns to cinemas in 4K for its 20th anniversary

Sofia Coppola's riotous Marie Antoinette celebrates its landmark 20th anniversary in 2026 and returns to cinemas courtesy of Park Circus from 13 November 2026. Beloved by audiences and more popular than ever on social media, the time has never been better for Madame Déficit to return to the big screen.

High On Films
The 20 Best Investigative Journalism Movies

Some investigative journalism movies offer insight into uncovering truths and exposing corruption. "All the President's Men" (1976) follows Bob Woodward and Carl Bernstein as they investigate the Watergate scandal, showing the power of persistent reporting. "Spotlight" (2015) portrays The Boston Globe's exposé on systemic child abuse within the Catholic Church. "The Post" (2017) focuses on The Washington Post's decision to publish the Pentagon Papers. In "Zodiac" (2007), the pursuit of a serial killer emphasizes dedication amidst danger. "Nightcrawler" (2014) explores…

Must-see Malkovich - celebrating the Wild Horse Nine star’s incredible career

Awards-season buzz is already everywhere by this time of year, but it's hard to imagine anyone feeling cynical about some recognition for the great John Malkovich and his universally acclaimed turn in Martin McDonagh's latest black comedy Wild Horse Nine.

The Prince Charles Cinema
THE HISTORY OF CONCRETE at the PCC!

After selling out its two Preview Shows on 26th December and 6th January, John Wilson’s THE HISTORY OF CONCRETE will screen daily on release from Friday 8th January! Get your tickets now to see this incredible new documentary from the mind behind “How To with John Wilson”.

READ STORY
Cinema Middelburg
Coyote vs. Acme

Wile E. Coyote sleept ACME Corporation voor de rechter nadat opnieuw een poging om de Road Runner te vangen volledig mislukt en hem niets anders oplevert dan een berg defecte producten. Met de hulp van de uitgerangeerde advocaat Kevin Avery neemt hij het op tegen het bedrijf achter de producten die hem keer op keer in de problemen brengen. Het resultaat is een komisch live-action/animatie-avontuur waarin Coyote eindelijk terugvecht tegen ACME.

Busan International Film Festival
The Power of Cinema: 26 Voices of Cineastes

From October 6 to 15, more than 7,000 guests and 200,000 festivalgoers gathered in Busan to celebrate the art of cinema, its remarkable stories, and the brilliant filmmakers behind them. To mark these unforgettable encounters, BIFF posed a single question to 26 film icons who joined us for the 31st edition, inviting them to share their heartfelt messages with film lovers around the world:

You Can See Everything

Äntligen Sverigepremiär för denna snackis till film. Känns som att det var längesedan en dokumentär varit så hypead. Vi är förväntansfulla och glada att premiärvisningen nu nästan är slutsåld. Fler datum tillkommer så klart. You Can See Everything har Sverigepremiär 21 november. Biljetter hittar du på cnema.se

Tokyo International Film Festival
[Animation Symposium] Women Directors- Diverse Visions – Paving the Way for the Next Generation

While women are gaining more opportunities than ever within animation to showcase their talent in leadership roles and as directors on major projects, equity has yet to be reached. Recognizing how far things have come, as well as how far there is still to go, a symposium entitled Women Directors: Diverse Visions was held at the 39th Tokyo International Film Festival to address what can be done to reach the goal of parity.
